correctness.rationale: An explicit C1-admissible monotone family has x*=1, Lg=2 and max_[m,M] h'=1+A, so the conjectured Theorem 3.6 inequality holds for every delay, while the exact source linearization has A=1.01, B=2e^-0.01 and is unstable for tau>1.236578.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly leaves this max-slope nonlinear extension as an unproved conjecture. Exact-title, DOI, theorem-number, quoted-phrase, counterexample, and equivalent-formulation searches found no correction or source-specific resolution. Standard scalar DDE stability theory is not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The construction refutes a concrete recent conjecture with an arbitrarily strong separation between the proposed sufficient quantity and the true local stability threshold, and identifies the structural reason that a maximum derivative cannot serve as uniform damping.
